title: Pocket filters
description: Pocket filters with a large filtration surface — for fine filtration in offices, schools and shopping centres, or as pre-filters for industrial processes.
paragraphs: Pocket filters have pockets made of microfine glass fibre or polyester nonwoven media with a special design that ensures optimised airflow distribution combined with moderate energy consumption. The filter pockets provide a large filtration surface.

Whether the air filter is installed as a fine filter in office buildings, schools or shopping centres, or as a primary pre-filter for industrial processes, it is an excellent solution for both better indoor climate and low operating costs.
